definitions.copy: same content_sha256, or shingle(5) Jaccard >= 0.8 over the pipeline-tokenised body
definitions.unit: copies ∪ same-story membership; assigned whole to one split by its earliest article's day — so no KNOWN same-story pair or copy straddles; a CANDIDATE pair can, is stamped `straddles`, and is then excluded from the adjudicable test set
definitions.split: test = units whose earliest day >= boundary, boundary chosen so the unit test share is closest to 0.3
definitions.strong_candidate: >= 2 shared title tokens with the candidate story
definitions.cross_outlet: the article's domain is not among the candidate story's members published BEFORE the article
definitions.candidate_population: candidate_stories() over the frozen index restricted to stories with a member published before the article, excluding its own story
definitions.strata_basis: article strata counted over the raw window AND the publishable subset; same_person is a PAIR stratum (weak title overlap, a person the article names among the entity hits)
definitions.labels: NULL throughout — this is the frame, not the adjudication
